strategy_summary: Merged plan (owner decision of 2026-10-15 takes precedence): AI produces files, the owner verifies locally, approves, publishes and gets paid. Risk-first proposal (avg score 7.0 vs Cash-first 6.25 and Automation-first 5.25) is the governance base: hard Day-0 compliance gate on the publish click only, no client personal data, listing lint, kill criteria. Grafted in: Cash-first's fixed-scope fixed-price service on buyers who already state a need (without 숨고 outreach, which cannot fit the owner's 2-3 h/week), and Automation-first's parallel build+QA pipeline. Single platform: 크몽 (KRW payout to own account, no business registration needed to start, templates and services in one place). First batch = 4 digital products (월간 매출·광고 리포트 템플릿, 엑셀·CSV 병합 파이썬 키트 [source only, no exe], 셀러 순마진 계산기, 수입·경비 기록 장부 [recording only]) + 1 service listing (개인정보 없는 엑셀·CSV 정리 + 지표 요약, STANDARD/DELUXE only). All 5 are built and QA'd in one batch, but only 2 digital files + the service go live in the first 60 days (the two that double as portfolio for the service); the other 2 after day 60. Honest expectation: net income months 1-3 = 0 KRW (P(order within 30 days) about 10-20%, P(cash within 30 days) 10% or less; both are judgment, not statistics); months 6-12 combined 0-200,000 KRW/month before tax and insurance effects; month cash outlay cap 100,000 KRW. No new-seller income statistics exist anywhere; the 12-month purpose is market validation, reviews/portfolio and pipeline skill, not income. Owner time budget conflict flagged: week 0-2 setup needs about 6-10 h, steady state about 2.5-3 h/week only with 크몽-only, daily 10-minute check window, 3 new service orders/month cap and no 숨고 outreach.

first_batch.spec: GOAL: a paste-and-read monthly report workbook. Sheets (Korean names): 00_사용법 (3-step guide, colour legend: yellow=input, grey=formula/do-not-edit, light-blue=result; warning to DELETE buyer name/phone/address columns before pasting; unofficial notice; AI-disclosure sentence; disclaimer: calculation aid only); 01_주문데이터 (columns: 주문일, 상품명, 옵션(선택), 수량, 결제금액, 채널(자유입력), 취소/반품여부 [Y/N]; NO personal-data columns; user pastes own data in this order; do NOT claim compatibility with any platform export); 02_광고데이터 (일자, 광고비, 노출, 클릭, 광고주문수, 광고매출); 03_상품목록 (user types up to 50 product names; do NOT use UNIQUE/SORT/dynamic arrays); 04_지표요약 with 6 KPI groups: (1) 총매출 = SUMIFS(결제금액, 취소/반품여부,'N'), 주문 수 = COUNTIFS, 객단가 = 총매출/주문 수; (2) 상품별 매출 TOP5 via SUMIFS per product + LARGE/INDEX-MATCH with a tie-break helper column; (3) 요일별 매출 via helper WEEKDAY column; (4) 취소/반품률; (5) 광고 CPC, 전환율 (광고주문/클릭); (6) ROAS = 광고매출/광고비; charts: daily revenue line, weekday bar, TOP5 bar, ROAS trend (openpyxl charts); 05_해석메모 (fill-in-the-blank prompts only, NO auto-generated conclusions); 06_계산식설명 (every formula explained in plain Korean, so the owner can explain it); 07_샘플데이터(가상) (about 300 synthetic rows for one month + ad rows, fixed random seed, labeled 'sample, synthetic data'). FUNCTIONS: SUMIFS, COUNTIFS, SUMPRODUCT, INDEX/MATCH, LARGE, WEEKDAY, IFERROR, TEXT only; no LET/LAMBDA/XLOOKUP/dynamic arrays; no macros (.xlsx), no external links, no hidden sheets. All divisions wrapped to show a friendly message instead of errors. BUILD: openpyxl or XlsxWriter script kept in build_notes. ACCEPTANCE: AC-01 LibreOffice headless recalculation leaves 0 error cells (#REF!,#DIV/0!,#NAME?,#VALUE!,#N/A) in every sheet; AC-02 the 6 KPI groups on the synthetic data equal a pandas reference computation (amounts +-1 KRW, ratios +-0.01 pp); AC-03 edge inputs (0 orders, empty ad sheet, 0 clicks, blank rows, unregistered product) show guidance text not errors; AC-04 no macros, 0 external links (link list empty), 0 hidden sheets, 0 personal-data columns; AC-05 owner opens in real Windows Excel without warnings, 4 charts render, no broken Korean; AC-06 every guide screenshot matches the final file (if captured from LibreOffice, say so in build_notes and let the owner decide to recapture 2 images in Excel); AC-07 every capability claimed in listing.md is demonstrable in the file. LISTING: title style '월간 매출·광고 성과 리포트 템플릿 (엑셀, 붙여넣으면 핵심 지표 6개 계산)'; sections: what you get (sheet list), requirements (Excel 2016+ or Google Sheets upload), before/after preview, FAQ, AI-disclosure sentence 'AI 도구를 활용해 제작하고 제작자가 직접 검수·테스트했습니다', digital-file refund text per 크몽 base wording (no blanket 환불 불가). FORBIDDEN CLAIMS: revenue/ROAS improvement, 'auto analysis' hype, platform export compatibility, superlatives (최고/최대/유일), external contacts, income figures, AI-generated people. DISCLAIMER on platform names: used descriptively only, unofficial, no logos or UI captures. Owner can reach any file defect within 24h answer time. PORTFOLIO USE: the service DELUXE sample report is produced from this template's synthetic data.

first_batch.spec: GOAL: reusable merge/cleanup of many Excel/CSV files into one table. NO exe, NO PyInstaller/UPX (R20). BEHAVIOUR: reads every .xlsx/.csv in an input folder (state only tested formats); never modifies originals; config.json controls file pattern, sheet selection, header row position, column-name mapping (different labels to one), whitespace/case normalization, date-format unification, duplicate-removal key columns, output file name; appends '원본파일' and '원본시트' columns; writes merged.xlsx (optional csv) and merge_report.txt (rows read, duplicates dropped, files skipped with reason); CSV encoding auto-try utf-8, utf-8-sig, cp949 with a clear Korean error on failure; Korean error messages and FAQ (install failure, encoding error, file open in Excel). SAMPLES: 5 deliberately messy synthetic sets (header row at different positions, different column labels, mixed date formats, exact duplicate rows, empty rows/columns, a cp949 CSV) plus golden output files. ACCEPTANCE: AC-01 fresh Windows venv: pip install -r requirements.txt, run on samples, output equals golden file cell by cell; AC-02 unit tests pass (header variants, encodings, duplicates, empty input, missing folder, file locked/open); AC-03 zero network calls: AST import scan plus tests run with sockets blocked; ONLY after this passes may the listing say 'data stays on your PC'; AC-04 secrets/absolute-path/personal-string scan = 0; dependency licences checked (pandas BSD-3, openpyxl MIT, numpy BSD, etc.), no GPL code, recorded in THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.txt; AC-05 LICENSE_TERMS: personal/in-house use allowed, no redistribution/resale, no warranty, no 'exclusive copyright' wording (AI output is protected only where human creative contribution exists); AC-06 zip SHA-256 recorded and shown in the listing; AC-07 Korean README lets a beginner go from install to first merged file. LISTING: show before/after sample, state honestly that free alternatives exist (e.g. Excel Power Query) and what this offers (rules in a config file, repeatable runs), requirements (Windows, Python 3.x install steps included), AI-disclosure sentence, refund text per 크몽 base wording. FORBIDDEN: 'no antivirus warning' promises, speed guarantees, claims of safe handling of personal data, superlatives, income claims, external contacts. SERVICE LINK: this script is the base of the STANDARD service deliverable and evidence of Python-automation skill; owner must be able to explain every step of the script.

first_batch.spec: PACKAGES: STANDARD (30,000): up to 3 files merged/cleaned, one cleanup rule set (column unification / duplicate removal / format unification, pick 1-2), output xlsx + short usage note, 1 revision, delivery 3 business days. DELUXE (80,000): STANDARD + summary sheet + 6 key metrics + charts + one-page interpretation memo (PDF or Excel) + re-runnable script source with README, 2 revisions, delivery 5 business days. NO PREMIUM (scheduled run, Google Sheets integration, dashboards, deployment need client credentials/hosting = R14). Revision rule aligned with 크몽 terms (revision request within 7 days of receipt; further revisions may be declined once the listed scope is fulfilled). Delivery days are concrete business days (no vague timing). Refund wording is at least the legal minimum. NOT PROVIDED (state in listing and intake): files with personal data (buyer names/phones/addresses/accounts), login-required collection, crawling of Naver/Coupang/SNS etc., thesis/assignment statistics, client passwords/API keys/server access, monthly maintenance or incident response, accuracy/security/business-outcome guarantees, legal/tax/medical/investment judgement, hosting/deployment. CRAWLING IS OUT of the first wave; wave 2 may add a separate listing limited to client-owned/authorised pages, official open APIs, or pages whose robots.txt and ToS allow it (R15). WORKFLOW (document it): client file stays on the owner PC; AI only sees schema, masked sample or synthetic data; a separate verifier agent tests on synthetic data; owner runs on the real file locally, must be able to explain every formula/script (else decline/do not deliver), then clicks 'send deliverable'; client personal data discovered = stop, tell client, delete; client files deleted within 30 days after 구매확정 with a log. CAPACITY: max 3 new orders per month; reply within 24h via one fixed 10-minute daily window + auto-reply; use 휴가 모드 when away; below 4 h/week run at most this one service. UNIT ECONOMICS: STANDARD nets about 23,490; at 2-3 owner hours that is about 7.8-11.7k KRW/h, i.e. at or below the 2026 minimum wage (10,320, re-check) so STANDARD is a deliberate entry tier capped at 3 orders; log owner hours per order. LISTING LINT (must pass): no 최고/최초/유일/무제한 A/S, no external contacts/links, no '견적 별도 협의', no unproven credentials or awards, no income or result promises, no AI-generated people, samples never attributed to a client; owner introduced honestly as a learner with a verifiable portfolio; AI sentence: 'AI 도구를 활용해 제작하고 제작자가 직접 검수·테스트했습니다' (never claim hand-made or no-AI). PRICE RATIONALE cites 크몽 guides (Excel avg about 70k, data preprocessing avg 120k+, performance report 150-400k, 2025-09, platform self-published, methodology undisclosed) and fee math; state that net excludes income tax/insurance. human_setup_checklist: Day 0-3: create the 크몽 account, complete ID verification, register a bank account in your own name, write an honest learner profile (no invented career, no AI-generated face) - owner only.

Day 0-3: send/hold the Day-0 questions and record date, counterpart and answer in docs/02_Day0_게이트_기록.md: 건강보험공단 (피부양자 status; business registration vs business income limit 5M KRW/yr), KDT 훈련기관 + 고용센터 1350 (does side income/사업자등록 affect the training stipend; written answer; compare with the reported up-to-200,000 KRW/month), 취업규칙 겸업금지 if employed.

Day 0-3: call 세무서 126 or a 세무사: when to register (default: by the first paid order, 간이과세 candidate), 업종코드, VAT on services/digital files, does 크몽 withhold 3.3% (confirm on the first settlement statement), 통신판매업 exemption via 시·군·구청/정부24; never split continuous work into 기타소득.

Day 0-3: send the 크몽 1:1 question (AI drafts the text) asking whether products/services made with AI tools and checked by the seller are allowed and how to state it; keep the written answer; stop the format within 24h if restricted.

compliance_rules: R1 Day-0 gate before ANY publish click (building continues in parallel): 건강보험 피부양자 status (with business registration business income is generally not allowed, otherwise up to 5M KRW/yr), written answer from 훈련기관/고용센터 1350 on KDT/내일배움카드 stipend vs 사업자등록 or side income, 취업규칙 겸업금지, 세무서 126/세무사 on registration timing, 업종코드, 간이과세, VAT. If anything is unclear, do not publish. Log in docs/02_Day0_게이트_기록.md.

R2 Registration trigger is 'continuous and repeated' activity, not an amount; apply within 20 days of start. Default: register (간이과세 candidate) no later than the first paid order unless 세무서/세무사 says otherwise in writing. Never route repeat work through 기타소득 to avoid registration and never avoid registration to protect 건보 status. 크몽 reports seller sales to the tax office quarterly.

R3 Do not assume 크몽 withholds 3.3% (unverified): read the first settlement statement and record deductions. Plan on 3.3% (the 2.2% proposal is not law). 간이과세 납부면제 (under 48M KRW) is not a filing exemption. Keep a monthly ledger, file 종합소득세 in May, keep records at least 5 years (confirm with 세무사).

R4 통신판매업: confirm exemption (간이과세자 or fewer than 50 prior-year transactions) with 시·군·구청/정부24, re-check when volume or tax status changes; exemption does not remove display, withdrawal and refund duties.

R5 Before listing, send 크몽 a written 1:1 question about AI-assisted creation and keep the answer. 크몽 service policy (2025.06.25) has no AI clause, but e-book/template guides require the owner's own verifiable work. If restricted, stop that format within 24 hours.

R6 Truthful disclosure on every listing and PDF: 'AI 도구를 활용해 제작하고 제작자가 직접 검수·테스트했습니다'. Never claim hand-made or no-AI. Keep a per-product test log. AI Basic Act (in force 2026-01-22) labeling duty falls on AI businesses, individuals are generally users, grace period at least 1 year (end date unconfirmed): voluntary disclosure is the safe default.

R7 No AI-generated people anywhere (profile photo, thumbnails, portfolio, intro video, fake customers/experts). If ever used in promotion, label [가상인물] per the 크몽 notice of 2026-06-05 and the 공정위 rule in force since 2026-06-01 (exposure up to 2% of related sales, criminal exposure).

R8 Listing lint blocks the review queue: no 최고/최초/유일/최저가, no 100%/무조건/무제한 A/S, no earnings/revenue/refund-of-tax promises, no unproven awards or career claims, no external contacts or links, no '견적 별도 협의', no vague delivery time, no refund terms worse than the legal minimum. Samples are labeled 'sample, synthetic data' and never attributed to a client.

R9 Describe the owner honestly as a learner with a verifiable portfolio; no 'expert', 'N years' or 'working professional' without proof (크몽 bars false career information). Experience-based text contains only steps the owner actually ran, with own screenshots.

R10 No fake/self/friend/family reviews or orders, no review-for-discount offers, no orders without real work, no price cuts to manufacture sales, one account per platform, payouts only to an account in the owner's own name.

R11 크몽 conduct: no contact details/external channels before a transaction, no pre-transaction call or consultation, no off-platform payment, no duplicate listings, no moving buyers off-platform. 숨고/위시켓 are not in the first wave; before use read terms and confirm payment, invoicing and withholding (direct payment = registered business income with invoice duties).

R12 Digital-file buyer protection: preview images/sample pages, exact contents list and 크몽 base refund wording on every file product; never a blanket '환불 불가'; answer file-defect requests within 24h; price with VAT in mind (ISBN-less PDF/templates widely treated as taxable, unconfirmed).

R13 Client data stays local: real client files never go to an external LLM, cloud or this repository; AI sees schemas, masked samples or synthetic data only; owner runs real data locally. If personal data arrives anyway: stop, tell the client, delete. Delete client files within 30 days after 구매확정 and log it. Scan client code for secrets before any AI reads it. Refuse unmasked e-commerce exports (buyer names/phones/addresses).

R14 Neither owner nor AI holds client passwords, API keys, server access or bank/card data; clients create and keep their own accounts and hosting. The AI never logs in anywhere; scheduled tasks only write local files.

R15 Collection gate for any scraping/collection job: allowed only for (a) data/pages the client owns or authorised in writing, (b) official open APIs within their 이용허락범위 (keep a screenshot of the licence page), (c) pages whose robots.txt and terms do not forbid automated collection (log the check). Banned: login-required pages, CAPTCHA/IP/user-agent evasion, any personal data (names, phones, emails, SNS handles, review-author IDs), bulk copying of copyrighted content, reselling collected databases. Naver, Coupang, SNS refused by default; rate limits; owner approves each target in writing. A criminal acquittal (Yanolja case) is not civil immunity (DB right, 부정경쟁방지법). Not in first-wave scope.

R16 Refuse list: personal-data collection/lookup, contact-list/DB building, thesis/assignment/cover-letter ghostwriting, trading/crypto/gambling/MLM tools, review/follower manipulation, spam/mass messaging, medical/health-supplement/financial/investment efficacy copy, apps with payments/health/children's/heavy personal data, security audits/certifications, anything needing a licence the owner lacks (세무사, 변호사, 노무사, 행정사).

R17 Tax/legal neutrality: ledgers and calculators record and total only; no built-in tax rates, no filing advice, no 환급/절세 claims, no legal conclusions; files say 'for recording and totalling only; not tax advice'; fee/rate cells are inputs with a 기준일 and official-source note.

R18 Platform names (네이버, 스마트스토어, 쿠팡) only descriptively with 'unofficial, no affiliation'; no logos or UI captures; claim format compatibility only if tested with a masked real sample (first wave makes no compatibility claim).

R19 Copyright/licences: never resell or reuse others' templates/forms/books; fonts, images, music only with logged commercial licences and fonts not bundled; open-source licence check (no GPL mixing) and secrets scan on delivered code; AI output is protected only where human creative contribution exists, so never advertise 'exclusive copyright' or originality warranty; state ownership/use rights of service deliverables.

R20 Executables: no single-file PyInstaller exe or UPX for ordinary buyers; if unavoidable, one-folder build + source + SHA-256 + VirusTotal note, never promise 'no antivirus warning'; code signing is outside the cash cap. 'Data never leaves your PC' may be claimed only after code review and a network check.

R21 Landing pages/forms (wave 2): client supplies copy and images; owner never writes regulated claims; forms collecting personal data use the client's consent text and privacy policy; do not host ad/payment sites on Vercel Hobby or GitHub Pages (check Cloudflare Pages' official terms); no AI-generated realistic people/testimonials.

R22 Scope/liability/verification: every service states scope, deliverables, revision count (aligned with 크몽's 7-day revision rule), business-day delivery and exclusions; no accuracy/security/business-outcome guarantee; first 90 days no maintenance retainers, uptime/security guarantees, payment or heavy-PII apps, or scheduled jobs for clients. The builder is never the verifier: synthetic-data tests, then owner runs on own Windows/Excel/Python before delivery; if the owner cannot explain it, decline or do not deliver; no thesis statistics. Any AI-caused refund/complaint pauses that product until a new test step exists.

R23 Scale caps and dedupe: one margin calculator in the whole plan; at most 2 digital files live in the first 60 days, then max 2 new per month; max 2 variants per base file with genuinely different data/workflow; no industry-by-industry mass copies; each new product needs at least one unique element the owner personally tested; respect 크몽's own-work and no-duplicate-listing rules.

R24 AI-feature paid services (chatbots, RAG, AI web apps) are excluded for the first year; they may make the owner an 'AI 이용사업자' under the AI Basic Act; realistic synthetic images/voice/video need a visible AI label.

R25 Owner-only actions: account creation, ID/KYC, ToS acceptance, bank details, listing submission, every reply/quote, delivery click, withdrawal, tax filing. The AI never sends, posts, submits, publishes or accepts; every outgoing message, submission and delivery has a dated 'owner approved' record; no auto-reply text without prior owner approval; tracker approve/reject is owner-only; scheduled tasks never use logged-in sessions.

R26 Foreign platforms (Notion Marketplace, Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, Payhip, Etsy, Apify) only after domestic tax setup, and only after the owner confirms Korean-individual payout on the sign-up screen; foreign income is reportable in May and VAT/영세율 needs a 세무사; no crypto payouts (e.g. Telegram Stars via Toncoin).

R27 Income honesty: all income figures are internal estimates and never appear in listings, marketing or messages; 0 KRW in months 1-3 is the baseline, not failure; always state P(order within 30 days) about 10-20% and P(cash within 30 days) 10% or less as judgment, not statistics; treat claims like 'top 10% earn 6.63M KRW' as marketing.

R28 Monthly policy watch (docs/03_정책_점검_기록.md): 크몽 expert-center notices, 공정위 guidance, AI Basic Act grace-period end date (reports imply not before 2027-01-22; unconfirmed), withholding-rate bill, fee tables of platforms in use; date-stamp every policy fact with source URL and 'checked on'; flag facts older than 6 months as possibly stale; re-verify known unknowns at Day 0 and quarterly.

R29 Unit economics: compute net with the 크몽 수익금 계산기 and log owner hours per order; after three consecutive orders below the 2026 minimum wage (10,320 KRW, re-check) raise price, narrow scope or retire the tier, except the STANDARD entry tier capped at its first 3 orders; always state that net figures exclude income tax and health-insurance effects.

R30 Capacity and cash: below 4 owner hours/week run at most 1 live service, use auto-reply and 휴가 모드; bootcamp attendance comes first and the owner can pause anytime; decline misfit inquiries instead of stretching scope; month cash outlay at most 100,000 KRW; stop all paid acquisition at cumulative 150,000 KRW with zero revenue; ads default OFF and at most one 49,000 KRW Rookie test on one already-improved service with inquiry signals; never put ads on a listing nobody asks about.
kpis: Leading (owner pastes weekly): 크몽 impressions and clicks per listing (baseline reference: 0.11 clicks/day without ads, platform average, so zero is normal early), inquiries, 24h reply rate (keep 90%+ or use 휴가 모드), listing approval status/rejection reasons.
Production quality: QA rounds per product, defects found, owner local-check rejections (target 0), AC pass rate.
Lagging: orders, gross sales, net received after fees/withholding (ledger.csv), refunds/complaints/payout holds (target 0), real buyer reviews and rating (no incentives).
Efficiency: owner hours per week (steady target 2-3, hard trigger at 6 for 4 weeks), owner hours per order, net per owner hour vs 2026 minimum wage 10,320 KRW (re-check).
Cost: monthly cash outlay (cap 100,000 KRW) and cumulative paid-acquisition spend (cap 150,000 KRW with zero revenue).
First-90-day pass line (decision aid, not a promise): at least 3 inquiries or at least 1 order across live listings.
Compliance: Day-0 answers logged (8 items), 크몽 AI written answer on file, lint violations at submit (target 0), policy-watch entries per month (target 1).
kill_criteria: K1 Before start: if Day-0 shows a high risk of losing 피부양자 status, the 훈련기관/고용센터 says side income or 사업자등록 hurts the training stipend, 취업규칙 forbids side work, or tax answers stay unclear, do not publish; keep building and revisit after resolution.

K2 Policy: if 크몽 (written answer, terms, notice) forbids or restricts AI-assisted products, or any warning/sales stop/payout hold arrives, stop that format within 24 hours, freeze new releases, analyse the cause first.
K3 Quality: any refund, complaint or payout hold traced to an AI or unverified error pauses that product and adds a test step; a second incident retires it.
K4 Data incident: client personal data received or leaked: stop the service immediately, notify, delete, and reopen only after the intake rules are fixed.
K5 Day 30: impressions/clicks but 0 inquiries -> improve title, thumbnail, samples, price once; no ads; if almost no impressions, check category/keywords.
K6 Day 60: no order after two positioning rewrites -> stop new production, hold wave B, focus on the one listing with the most inquiries.
K7 Day 90: 0 orders and 0 inquiries -> stop new registrations, keep samples, re-plan; do not increase spending.
K8 SKU level: 90 days with 0 orders -> one revision of title/preview/price; another 90 days with 0 -> archive; no variants.
K9 Week 24: still 0 sales -> end the model; never cut prices to manufacture sales.
K10 Time: owner above 6 h/week for 4 consecutive weeks AND net profit under 50,000 KRW/month -> reduce products or close the service; pause if bootcamp suffers.
K11 Cash: more than 100,000 KRW outlay in a month, or 150,000 KRW cumulative paid acquisition with zero revenue -> stop all paid acquisition.
K12 Unit economics: net per owner hour below minimum wage on 3 consecutive orders -> raise price, narrow scope or retire (STANDARD entry tier excepted for its first 3 orders).
K13 Service quality: among the first 4 orders repeated revision requests, 2 or more personal-data/ToS-problem requests, or rating below 4.0 -> close the service.
K14 Tax/insurance red flag: if 세무사/공단 shows registration or insurance cost clearly exceeds likely income, delay the first sale; never trade compliance for the goal.
